thread:
Elena: created PR with migration checklist + concrete retention examples and a Terraform snippet for customers to toggle export pseudonymization. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489. asking for legal + infra glance.
Jon: skimmed. good direction. can we include a canary/rollout playbook? exports may be heavy. :thinking_face: 
Priya: legal wants SOC2-aligned phrasing. avoid 'may' for controls. suggest: 'Audit logs include tenant and actor identifiers for operational troubleshooting. For analytic exports, these identifiers MUST be pseudonymized or removed according to the customer's configured export policy.'
Sam (docs): noted. I'll update wording. also adding concrete TTL table: 30d (short-term), 180d (default), 730d (archival). legal ok with those examples?
Priya: examples ok but mark them as examples only. also add line: 'Retention periods are governed by contract and customer policy.'
Elena: added Terraform snippet in PR for the toggle: ```hcl
resource "redwood_audit_config" "example" {
  org_id = "org-123"
  export_pseudonymize = true
  retention_days = 180
}
```
Jon: nice. infra note: if customers flip export_pseudonymize on, reprocessing old exports is optional and expensive. we should include a CLI helper and a one-time job example.
Sam (docs): added CLI helper: ```bash
redwood audit reprocess-exports --since 2023-01-01 --pseudonymize --org org-123
```
infra-bot: Warning: Reprocessing exports may hit storage/IO quotas. Recommend scheduled windows + incremental batches. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/export-guidelines
Jon: will coordinate the rollout plan. propose canary on 5% of orgs for 48h, monitor job queue depth and token spend.
Elena: added a short migration checklist to PR top-level and a Terraform example for customers using our provider. also included sample SDK snippets (JS + Ruby) for parity.
Sam (docs): pushed commit with JS snippet: ```js
await redwood.audit.export({ orgId: 'org-123', redact: true, retentionDays: 180 });
``` and Ruby: ```rb
Redwood::Audit.export(org_id: 'org-123', redact: true, retention_days: 180)
```
Priya: please change 'redact' to 'pseudonymize' in public docs wording, per legal taxonomy.
Sam (docs): replaced redact -> pseudonymize across examples. also fixed a broken API anchor and added cross-link to export billing note.
compliance-bot: Automated check: Missing SOC2 control mapping table for CC7/CC8. Add mapping or mark as N/A.
Elena: adding mapping table now, linking to controls doc.
Sam (docs): added mapping table and a short note on evidence collection for auditors (what to provide, timestamps, sample pseudonymization logs).
Jon: infra ack: will run canary and provide rollout window. please add the ops runbook link in the PR.
Sam (docs): added ops runbook link and a small note for customers about contract-level retention overrides.
Priya: legal final signoff after tiny punctuation nit. :white_check_mark:
Jon: infra ack too. we'll coordinate maintenance message.
Sam (docs): merged PR and updated release notes. closing branch. thanks all! :tada:
